deberta-small.name: cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-small
deberta-small.initialization: NLI encoder and pooler reused; three-way NLI classifier replaced with a seeded random binary KEEP/REJECT head. All parameters fine-tuned.

bert-tiny.name: google/bert_uncased_L-2_H-128_A-2
bert-tiny.initialization: Pretrained encoder with seeded random binary sequence classifier; all parameters fine-tuned.

truncation: Title preserved in full; Body prefix plus leading body tokens within 256 tokens; missing body uses title plus empty Body prefix. Title overflow fails open and aborts training.
loss: Training-only inverse-frequency class weights multiplied by quality weight, normalized to mean one over train partition. Quality: described/high=1, described/medium=0.75, title-only/medium=0.25. A: description-only training; B=C: all binary. Shared unweighted binary validation for controlled checkpoint and threshold comparison.
checkpointSelection: Lowest validation cross entropy among fixed epochs; no evaluation-label access for checkpoint or threshold selection.
operatingPoints: For each fold, choose largest threshold satisfying validation KEEP recall >=99%, >=98%, and 100%, using grid plus validation KEEP-score boundary. Freeze it before scoring employer-held-out evaluation. Aggregate held-out predictions; never adjust thresholds to fix evaluation errors.
cache: Previously holdout-excluded 1503 cache, scored only by employer-out fold; never training. Corpus 3198 also cross-fitted, AMBIGUOUS outside binary metrics.
diagnostics: Evaluation-only employer-name masking and body-tail truncation sensitivity. Employer AND lexical-title-family/duplicate-component disjoint partitions.
selectionBoundary: 36 fixed fits: 2 models x 2 views x 3 regimes x 3 folds. No hyperparameter changes based on outer scores; validation-selected thresholds and post-hoc descriptive frontiers separated. No production holdout or generative inference.
